result.summary: The page is largely intact, with no broken functionality. The main visual problems are minor: low-contrast promo banner text, ambiguous promo wording, and inconsistent delivery-time badge styling/alignment in the restaurant carousel.

issues.description: The promo banner's text and discount code are rendered in a low-contrast pale green on the green gradient background, making them noticeably harder to read than the white headline.
issues.suggestion: Use white or a much lighter tint for the supporting text and promo code, or add a darker overlay behind the text to improve contrast.

issues.description: The promo copy reads "3 free deliveries for you" with a minimum order of €10, which is inconsistent with delivering three free orders and is confusing about what the offer actually includes.
issues.suggestion: Clarify the offer wording, e.g. "3 free deliveries" with the €10 minimum order stated separately, so the conditions are unambiguous.

issues.description: In the "Fastest near you" row, the "20–30 min" badge on the Smash Bros Burgers card overlaps the restaurant photo instead of sitting cleanly in a consistent badge treatment like the neighboring cards, and it is vertically offset relative to the other badges.
issues.suggestion: Align all delivery-time badges to the same position and use a consistent badge style across carousel cards.
